known_limitations: No live HTTP round-trip against a running Jellyfin server was performed for task 5.11. The supported server image-response path is validated in-process by loading the pinned host Jellyfin.Api.dll and invoking the real Jellyfin.Api.Controllers.ImageController actions with a real DefaultHttpContext and DispatchProxy host doubles (ILibraryManager, IProviderManager, IImageProcessor), plus the existing task 5.1 route/authorization reflection tests over the same assembly. All task 5.11 documentation states this explicitly; the previous 'real HTTP round-trip' and '64x48/16x12' live-run claims were removed because no live-run artifacts or logs exist to support them.

The full ArrTags generation-to-publication pipeline was not driven end-to-end on a host because the Phase 6 queue/event wiring that triggers generation does not exist yet. The publish-then-read-back fact uses the real JellyfinArtworkImageWriter (real publication boundary) with a provider double that mirrors the supported ImageSaver write-and-update flow, then serves the derived bytes through the real pinned standard route; it does not exercise a real host ImageSaver or the host's on-disk image storage representation.

Live-host disable/uninstall/restore validation was not performed; the task 5.9 guarded restoration/removal and task 5.7 reconciliation behavior is demonstrated by integration tests with injectable host doubles. The Phase 5 acceptance criteria were marked complete on that integration-test basis and each carries an explicit caveat.

The in-process route facts use a Movie as the representative BaseItem; the pinned ImageController item-image actions are item-type-generic (BaseItem), and V1 Movie/Episode poster eligibility is covered by the task 5.10 EnhancedCoexistenceTests. The writer itself confines publication to the unindexed Primary surface for any item.

Gate 5 is recorded as met for the selected Jellyfin 12.0.0 ABI at the integration-test level. The running-host on-disk representation and a live end-to-end standard-route read-back remain listed under 'Still needing live-host validation' in docs/research/jellyfin-12-architecture.md section 4.4.
